id.description: Unique id (r1, r2…): what feedback targets.

label.description: What happens, as a short verb phrase (Reads orders, Publishes OrderPlaced).

order.description: The step number on a dynamic chart; defaults to list order.

ref.description: Another chart (by name, any format — e.g. the sequence chart of this call); drawn as Open ↗ on the arrow.

data.description: The data schema kind the call carries; a chip that opens that schema.

links.description: Code, docs or assets behind this call.
